suggested_answer: Granular Locking Explanation The term that describes the situation when you make changes to roles and groups Salesforce locks the entire group membership table is Granular Locking. Granular Locking is a feature that improves the concurrency and performance of sharing operations by locking only the affected nodes in the role or territory hierarchy, instead of locking the entire hierarchy.
